description: Minimal docs site: sidebar nav with grouped links, long-form article, code blocks, blue accent only for active/links.

referenceProfile.thesis: Docs as plain text infrastructure: one blue accent marks links and active nav, everything else is neutral type, hairlines, and light code surfaces.
signatureMoves: Sidebar groups use small uppercase labels to chunk navigation without icons.
Code sits on #f6f8fa blocks so commands read as objects on the page.
transferPreserve: Keep the single blue accent for links and active states; use hairline dividers for structure.
transferAvoid: Do not add marketing heroes, cards with shadows, or multiple accent colors.
